text_en: When the Gentiles all around heard that the altar had been rebuilt and the sanctuary dedicated as it was before, they became very angry,
text_cn: 四邻的异民听说犹太人重建了祭坛，重新祝圣了圣所，恢复旧观，于是大怒，

text_en: and they determined to destroy the descendants of Jacob who lived among them. So they began to kill and destroy among the people.
text_cn: 决意要铲除自己中间的雅各伯的后裔，就开始屠杀犹太人，加以清除。

text_en: But Judas made war on the descendants of Esau in Idumea, at Akrabattene, because they kept lying in wait for Israel. He dealt them a heavy blow and humbled them and despoiled them.
text_cn: 那时犹大在依杜默雅的阿卡巴特乃，攻打正在包围以色列人的厄撒乌的后裔，加以痛击，予以重创；制服他们，获得了许多财物。

text_en: He also remembered the wickedness of the sons of Baean, who were a trap and a snare to the people and ambushed them on the highways.
text_cn: 他又想起贝红人的恶行，这些人常作犹太人的罗网和绊脚石，埋伏在路上窥伺陷害。

text_en: They were shut up by him in their towers; and he encamped against them, vowed their complete destruction, and burned with fire their towers and all who were in them.
text_cn: 犹大将他们包围在碉堡里，安营攻打，下了毁灭令，遂放火将碉堡和其中所有的人焚烧了。

text_en: Then he crossed over to attack the Ammonites, where he found a strong band and many people, with Timothy as their leader.
text_cn: 以后去攻打阿孟子民时，遭遇了强悍大军，军长是提摩太，

text_en: He engaged in many battles with them, and they were crushed before him; he struck them down.
text_cn: 两军交战多次，敌军终为犹大所击败，犹大追杀他们，

text_en: He also took Jazer and its villages; then he returned to Judea.
text_cn: 占据了雅则尔及所属村镇，然后回师犹太。

text_en: Now the Gentiles in Gilead gathered together against the Israelites who lived in their territory, and planned to destroy them. But they fled to the stronghold of Dathema,
text_cn: 基肋阿得的异民聚集起来，攻击住在他们境内的以色列人，要消除他们；于是以色列人逃到达特玛堡垒里，

text_en: and sent to Judas and his brothers a letter that said, “The Gentiles around us have gathered together to destroy us.
text_cn: 写信给犹大及他的兄弟们说：“我们四周的异民都聚集起来攻打我们，要铲除我们。

text_en: They are preparing to come and capture the stronghold to which we have fled, and Timothy is leading their forces.
text_cn: 他们正准备来夺取我们避难的堡垒，提摩太是他们的军长；

text_en: Now then, come and rescue us from their hands, for many of us have fallen,
text_cn: 所以现在，请你来拯救我们，脱离他们的手！我们已有许多人丧生。

text_en: and all our kindred who were in the land of Tob have been killed; the enemy have captured their wives and children and goods, and have destroyed about a thousand persons there. ”
text_cn: 住在托布的众弟兄已全被杀，妻子儿女被俘掳，财物被劫掠，在那里被杀的约有一千人。”

text_en: While the letter was still being read, other messengers, with their garments torn, came from Galilee and made a similar report;
text_cn: 正在读这封信时，又有从加里肋亚来使者，他们的衣服业已撕破，报告消息说：

text_en: they said that the people of Ptolemais and Tyre and Sidon, and all Galilee of the Gentiles, had gathered together against them “to annihilate us. ”
text_cn: “仆托肋买、提洛、漆冬，以及外方人的加里肋亚， 都已聚集起来，要消灭我们。”

text_en: When Judas and the people heard these messages, a great assembly was called to determine what they should do for their kindred who were in distress and were being attacked by enemies.
text_cn: 犹大与百姓一听见这些消息，立即召集全体大会，商讨怎样拯救蒙难和被敌人攻打的弟兄们。

text_en: Then Judas said to his brother Simon, “Choose your men and go and rescue your kindred in Galilee; Jonathan my brother and I will go to Gilead. ”
text_cn: 犹大对哥哥息孟说：“你挑选一部分人，去援救加里肋亚的弟兄；我同弟弟约纳堂，往基肋阿得去。”

text_en: But he left Joseph, son of Zechariah, and Azariah, a leader of the people, with the rest of the forces, in Judea to guard it;
text_cn: 留下匝加黎雅的儿子若瑟和阿匝黎雅，管理军民，派他们与其余的军队守护犹太。

text_en: and he gave them this command, “Take charge of this people, but do not engage in battle with the Gentiles until we return. ”
text_cn: 又吩咐他们说：“你们只管理百姓，不要与异民交战，直到我回来。”

text_en: Then three thousand men were assigned to Simon to go to Galilee, and eight thousand to Judas for Gilead.
text_cn: 于是拨给息孟三千人，往加里肋亚去，犹大率领八千人，往基肋阿得去。

text_en: So Simon went to Galilee and fought many battles against the Gentiles, and the Gentiles were crushed before him.
text_cn: 息孟到了加里肋亚，与异民打了几仗，异民终不支溃败；

text_en: He pursued them to the gate of Ptolemais; as many as three thousand of the Gentiles fell, and he despoiled them.
text_cn: 息孟追击他们直到仆托肋买城门外，异民阵亡的约有三千；他获得了许多财物。

text_en: Then he took the Jews of Galilee and Arbatta, with their wives and children, and all they possessed, and led them to Judea with great rejoicing.
text_cn: 然后将住在加里肋亚和阿尔巴达的犹太人，同妻子儿女，以及所有的东西带回犹太，大家都很高兴。

text_en: Judas Maccabeus and his brother Jonathan crossed the Jordan and made three days’ journey into the wilderness.
text_cn: 犹大玛加伯和弟弟约纳堂，过了约但河，在旷野里行了三天的路；

text_en: They encountered the Nabateans, who met them peaceably and told them all that had happened to their kindred in Gilead:
text_cn: 纳巴泰人遇着他们，对他们表示欢迎，并将他们的弟兄在基肋阿得地的一切遭遇，报告给他们：

text_en: “Many of them have been shut up in Bozrah and Bosor, in Alema and Chaspho, Maked and Carnaim”—all these towns were strong and large—
text_cn: “他们中有许多人，怎样被困在波索辣、波索尔、阿肋玛、加斯佛、玛刻得和卡尔纳殷，这些城池都很坚固高大。

text_en: “and some have been shut up in the other towns of Gilead; the enemy are getting ready to attack the strongholds tomorrow and capture and destroy all these people in a single day. ”
text_cn: 还有被困在基肋阿得其他城中的，敌人决定明天进军攻打这些堡垒，计划在一天之内占领，并消灭其中所有的人。”

text_en: Then Judas and his army quickly turned back by the wilderness road to Bozrah; and he took the town, and killed every male by the edge of the sword; then he seized all its spoils and burned it with fire.
text_cn: 犹大领着军队，突然转变方向，经过旷野，到了波索辣，占据了那城，用刀杀尽所有的男丁，夺取了他们的一切财物，然后放火烧了那城。

text_en: He left the place at night, and they went all the way to the stronghold of Dathema.
text_cn: 从那里夜间起身，来到达特玛堡垒前，

text_en: At dawn they looked out and saw a large company, which could not be counted, carrying ladders and engines of war to capture the stronghold, and attacking the Jews within.
text_cn: 黎明时，举目一望，看见无数军民，带着云梯与器械，攻打堡垒，正向堡垒里的人攻击。

text_en: So Judas saw that the battle had begun and that the cry of the town went up to Heaven, with trumpets and loud shouts,
text_cn: 犹大见战事已起，杀声连天，角声喊声，混成一片，

text_en: and he said to the men of his forces, “Fight today for your kindred! ”
text_cn: 便向兵士说：“今天你们要为弟兄而战。”

text_en: Then he came up behind them in three companies, who sounded their trumpets and cried aloud in prayer.
text_cn: 遂从敌后分三队进军，同时一起吹角、呼喊、祈祷。

text_en: And when the army of Timothy realized that it was Maccabeus, they fled before him, and he dealt them a heavy blow. As many as eight thousand of them fell that day.
text_cn: 提摩太的军队，一认出是玛加伯，就望风而逃；玛加伯追击他们，予以重创，那一天敌方死的约有八千人。

text_en: Next he turned aside to Maapha, and fought against it and took it; and he killed every male in it, plundered it, and burned it with fire.
text_cn: 随后犹大转往阿肋玛，攻陷了那城，杀了所有的男丁，得了许多财物，然后放火将城烧了。

text_en: From there he marched on and took Chaspho, Maked, and Bosor, and the other towns of Gilead.
text_cn: 由此再往前进，将加斯佛、玛刻得、波索尔和基肋阿得的其余诸城都占领了。

text_en: After these things Timothy gathered another army and encamped opposite Raphon, on the other side of the stream.
text_cn: 这些事以后，提摩太又集合其他军队，在辣丰对面，河的那一边扎营。

text_en: Judas sent men to spy out the camp, and they reported to him, “All the Gentiles around us have gathered to him; it is a very large force.
text_cn: 犹大差人前去侦探敌军，他们回报说：“我们四周的异民，都与他们联合， 组成一支人数非常众多的军队，

text_en: They also have hired Arabs to help them, and they are encamped across the stream, ready to come and fight against you. ” And Judas went to meet them.
text_cn: 还雇用阿剌伯人来协助，都在河那边扎营，准备与你作战。”犹大就前去迎敌。

text_en: Now as Judas and his army drew near to the stream of water, Timothy said to the officers of his forces, “If he crosses over to us first, we will not be able to resist him, for he will surely defeat us.
text_cn: 当犹大和他的军队临近河旁时，提摩太向他的军官们说：“若犹大先渡到我们这边，我们就不能抵抗他，他必能制胜我们；

text_en: But if he shows fear and camps on the other side of the river, we will cross over to him and defeat him. ”
text_cn: 如果他畏惧，安营在河那边，我们就渡河到他那边去，我们必能制胜他。”

text_en: When Judas approached the stream of water, he stationed the officers of the army at the stream and gave them this command, “Permit no one to encamp, but make them all enter the battle. ”
text_cn: 犹大一近急流水旁，便将民间经师布置在河旁，命令他们说：“不准任何人留在营里，都应上阵作战。”

text_en: Then he crossed over against them first, and the whole army followed him. All the Gentiles were defeated before him, and they threw away their arms and fled into the sacred precincts at Carnaim.
text_cn: 犹大便先渡河到他们那边，众军人尾随在后。所有的异民一见，便立即溃散，抛下武器，逃往卡尔纳殷庙去了。

text_en: But he took the town and burned the sacred precincts with fire, together with all who were in them. Thus Carnaim was conquered; they could stand before Judas no longer.
text_cn: 犹太人又攻陷此城，将庙宇和其中众人，放火焚毁，卡尔纳殷遂被征服，从此不敢再反抗犹大。

text_en: Then Judas gathered together all the Israelites in Gilead, the small and the great, with their wives and children and goods, a very large company, to go to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 那时犹大将住在基肋阿得的全体以色列人，将他们及他们妻子儿女，不分老幼，集合起来，结成庞大的一群，带着他们所有的一切，返回犹太地。

text_en: So they came to Ephron. This was a large and very strong town on the road, and they could not go around it to the right or to the left; they had to go through it.
text_cn: 当他们临近厄斐龙时，──这是一座位于要道的大城，非常巩固，人只可从城中经过，左右不能通行。 ──

text_en: But the people of the town shut them out and blocked up the gates with stones.
text_cn: 城里的人将城门紧闭，且用石头堵塞起来。

text_en: Judas sent them this friendly message, “Let us pass through your land to get to our land. No one will do you harm; we will simply pass by on foot. ” But they refused to open to him.
text_cn: 犹大打发人到他们那里，措辞和气地向他们说：“请让我们从你们的地方经过，到我们的地方去；无人骚扰你们，我们只求步行过去。”但是他们仍不肯给以色列人开门。

text_en: Then Judas ordered proclamation to be made to the army that all should encamp where they were.
text_cn: 犹大便传令军中：每人驻扎在原处。

text_en: So the men of the forces encamped, and he fought against the town all that day and all the night, and the town was delivered into his hands.
text_cn: 士兵于是进攻，攻打了一日一夜，城便陷落在他们手里，

text_en: He destroyed every male by the edge of the sword, and razed and plundered the town. Then he passed through the town over the bodies of the dead.
text_cn: 他们用刀剑杀尽所有男子，将城彻底毁灭，得了许多财物，踏在死尸上，穿过城市。

text_en: Then they crossed the Jordan into the large plain before Beth-shan.
text_cn: 渡过约但，到了贝特商对面大平原。

text_en: Judas kept rallying the laggards and encouraging the people all the way until he came to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 犹大将那些迟迟在后的人集合起来，一路鼓励百姓，直至来到了犹太地。

text_en: So they went up to Mount Zion with joy and gladness, and offered burnt offerings, because they had returned in safety; not one of them had fallen.
text_cn: 大家兴高采烈地上熙雍山，献了全燔祭；他们中没有一个丧亡的都平安回来了。

text_en: Now while Judas and Jonathan were in Gilead and their brother Simon was in Galilee before Ptolemais,
text_cn: 当犹大与约纳堂在基肋阿得，他的哥哥息孟在加里肋亚攻打仆托肋买的时日，

text_en: Joseph son of Zechariah, and Azariah, the commanders of the forces, heard of their brave deeds and of the heroic war they had fought.
text_cn: 匝加黎雅的儿子若瑟和阿匝黎雅，这两个军长，听到他们作的大事和武功，

text_en: So they said, “Let us also make a name for ourselves; let us go and make war on the Gentiles around us. ”
text_cn: 就说：“我们自己也要成名，去与我们四周的异民作战。”

text_en: So they issued orders to the men of the forces that were with them and marched against Jamnia.
text_cn: 于是命令所属部队，向雅木尼雅进军，

text_en: Gorgias and his men came out of the town to meet them in battle.
text_cn: 哥尔基雅及其属下，便出城迎击。

text_en: Then Joseph and Azariah were routed, and were pursued to the borders of Judea; as many as two thousand of the people of Israel fell that day.
text_cn: 若瑟与阿匝黎雅败退，被追赶到犹太边境。那一天，以色列人死亡的约有两千。

text_en: Thus the people suffered a great rout because, thinking to do a brave deed, they did not listen to Judas and his brothers.
text_cn: 百姓这次所以遭受惨败，是因为这二人自信能成英雄，没有听从犹大及其他兄弟们的话，

text_en: But they did not belong to the family of those men through whom deliverance was given to Israel.
text_cn: 原来他们二人不属于解救以色列人的后裔。

text_en: The man Judas and his brothers were greatly honored in all Israel and among all the Gentiles, wherever their name was heard.
text_cn: 至于犹大本人和他的兄弟，大受全以色列及所有听到他们名声的异民所赞扬，

text_en: People gathered to them and praised them.
text_cn: 人人都聚到他们跟前欢呼。

text_en: Then Judas and his brothers went out and fought the descendants of Esau in the land to the south. He struck Hebron and its villages and tore down its strongholds and burned its towers on all sides.
text_cn: 犹大同他的兄弟们，又出征住在南方的厄撒乌子民，攻陷了赫贝龙及所属村镇，毁坏了城堡，焚烧了城墙四周的碉楼。

text_en: Then he marched off to go into the land of the Philistines, and passed through Marisa.
text_cn: 然后拔营前进，经过玛黎撒，来到培肋舍特人的地域。

text_en: On that day some priests, who wished to do a brave deed, fell in battle, for they went out to battle unwisely.
text_cn: 那一天一些司祭阵亡了，因为他们也想成英雄，轻率地出征作战。

text_en: But Judas turned aside to Azotus in the land of the Philistines; he tore down their altars, and the carved images of their gods he burned with fire; he plundered the towns and returned to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 犹大又转往培肋舍特人的地方阿左托，毁坏了他们的祭坛，焚烧了他们神像，抢掠了各城的财物，然后回了犹太地。
